title: The documented-workflow test needs an instruction to run the verify lane before the human review
description: The documented-workflow test needs an instruction to run the verify lane before the human review
no_spec_change_rationale: A test-only fix: the documented-workflow test counted any prose naming the verify lane as running it, and checked the order only at change review, so a page that no longer taught verify-then-review could still pass (DOCS-2). No spec or requirement text changes.
acceptance_criteria: The documented-workflow test fails when the README's verify-lane line is reworded so it no longer tells the reader to run the lane, and when the human-review line is moved above it; the README and landing page as written pass (red then green)
